description: Applied design matrix (Project.md section 8). The hand-built case applied/case_by_hand is the template; each run is generated by workflow/make_applied_case.py from this file.

numerics.kind: numerical; scalar_iters raised from 3000 to 5000 on 2026-10-13 because the chiller fractions were still moving at 3000 (notebook E11 addendum)

mesh.note: levels and boxes as in applied/case_by_hand/system/snappyHexMeshDict; building-fixed boxes rotate with the building (searchableRotatedBox), the wake box stays wind-aligned

blocks.note: Reduced matrix agreed 2026-10-13 (replaces the full A/B/C sweep; the sheet-parapet first pass is kept in results/applied as a record). Max two cases at once, 64 cores.

R1.purpose: along, across and reverse wind; 0 deg also the parapet-change comparison (decision 0012)

R3.purpose: flue-height design lever at the governing direction

R4.purpose: grid uncertainty band (GCI) at the governing condition

mesh_test.purpose: mesh-quality check of the solid parapet only; not run past the mesh stage
